oracle.protocol: -interaction=nonstopmode -halt-on-error, restricted shell-escape (the pdflatex default, OPEN-053), up to 3 passes: run to the first rc 0, then ONE confirming pass whose rc is authoritative; PDF recorded (compiles = rc 0 AND a PDF, STRICT_TIER_DESIGN.md B.4 E0)

agreement_rule: strict_differential.agrees_bytes (_strict_s0.agrees) on the extracted decide_bytes' verdict: READY iff rc 0 and a PDF; E0 iff rc 0 and no PDF, and neither the oracle nor the record gives a line (pdfTeX reports no l.N for E0); any other reason iff rc != 0, the first ! message is in _strict_s0.expected_messages(reason, token, mode), and the reported line (DecideBytes.ReportedLine) equals the oracle's l.N (both absent when the file ends). Line agreement is over the classes that have an l.N; E0 has none

upper_bound_95.scope: the disagreement rate over files drawn by THIS generator (version, weights, seed), not over L_S0: a class of files the generator does not draw is not bounded (C-85)
